_comment: Global pronunciation overrides for the narrator. Per-book pronunciations in story.json override these. Substitution is word-boundary + case-preserving; keys are matched case-insensitively. Values are the phonetic respelling ElevenLabs will actually receive — use hyphens for syllables and repeated vowels to lengthen (e.g. 'Daa-daa' > 'Dada' to steer away from short 'a').
